pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark regions with moderately defined pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is largest on the mid-flank and decreases in scale toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating patches. Junction nodes typically consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively constant across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck line, indicating a short mane.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, dark, raised textural anomaly is visible on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck/shoulder area, characterized by irregular surface geometry and deep pigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail is curled upward and forward, resting its terminal tuft on the dorsal surface of the rump.
